searchText: Hello Everyone, I am working on a DeFi App for a College minor project. Where can I get help to ask some doubt? r/ethdev, maybe on the cryptodevs discord (https://discord.gg/5W5tVb3), stackexchange Okay Thanks We are looking to read the data from a 3 dimensional mapping on solidity using assembly Example : `mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) private _allowances;` We know reading a two dimensional array could be done with the code below `function getStorageValue(uint num, uint slot) public view returns (address result) { assembly { // Store num in memory scratch space (note: lookup "free memory pointer" if you need to allocate space) mstore(0, num) // Store slot number in scratch space after num mstore(32, slot) // Create hash from previously stored num and slot let hash := keccak256(0, 64) // Load mapping value using the just calculated hash result := sload(hash) } ` But failed to figure out 3 dimensional arrays. To any Dev who knows how to do it, please share us your knowledge <@363955106850275331> I'm not a solidity dev, but iirc, for a nested map the separate keys are hashed together into one. You probably want to join an application-layer focused server for this kind of question. Here we just focus on protocol related things Hi Everyone, We're helping developers jump ship into crypto.
